name: B10-0199/2024 (S&D) – The increasing and systematic repression of women in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the increasing and systematic repression of women in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises Iran for its treatment of women, especially the case of Ahoo Daryaei, who was detained after protesting against compulsory headscarf rules. The Parliament calls on Iran to stop harassing women, scrap the morality police, and repeal laws that discriminate against women. It also urges the European Union's member states to support the United Nations fact-finding mission on Iran and to find ways to hold those responsible to account. The text is a statement of position, not a change in law.

- The Parliament asks Iran to end repression of women and abolish its morality police.
- It calls on European Union member states to back the United Nations fact-finding mission on Iran.
- The resolution is an opinion; it does not itself change any law or policy.
